_comment: Section 18.12 — Hybrid query: lexical (multi_match) + kNN combined via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. RRF needs no score normalisation: per doc, 1/(rank_constant + rank) is summed across both result lists, so score magnitude is irrelevant — only rank order. retriever.rrf is the ES 8.x top-level retrievers API (verified against Elastic RRF docs). query_vector must be produced by the SAME embedding service as the indexing pipeline, otherwise both sides operate in different vector spaces. POST /sw_product/_search
